character_brief: Akim is a compact miniature adult man with a naturally compressed dwarf-like build, floating upright in a relaxed neutral pose with two fully visible separate legs and natural joints. He calmly keeps one item within reach while one finger is gently poised to trace a future trajectory. Several long soft layers form a stepped contour around his narrow torso, and a tiny keepsake book rests against his wrist.

render_identity.subject: compact miniature adult human man
render_identity.proportion_cue: compact compressed torso, short limbs, and enlarged identity-bearing upper volume; never use ordinary full-sized human proportions
render_identity.neutral_pose: neutral upright levitation with two fully visible separated legs
